subject.title: Control UI: Debug snapshot refresh has no progress indicator and silently fails when disconnected

question: Should maintainers close/supersede the open fork PR path or adopt and rebase it as the fix for this Debug Snapshots issue?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible and narrow, but an open conflicting fork PR still uses closing syntax, so automation should not create a duplicate fix until maintainers choose that path.

options.title: Close the fork path and queue a fresh fix
options.body: Close or supersede the conflicting fork PR, then let a new narrow Control UI fix target the current `ui/src/pages/debug` files with tests and proof.

options.title: Adopt and rebase the fork PR
options.body: Have a maintainer or contributor rebase the fork branch onto current main and repair it against the current Debug page structure before review.

recommendation.title: Close the fork path and queue a fresh fix
recommendation.body: Close or supersede the conflicting fork PR, then let a new narrow Control UI fix target the current `ui/src/pages/debug` files with tests and proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter introduced the original Debug dashboard behavior and has the strongest provenance on the affected Control UI Debug surface.
